title_raw: Skilled Trade - Welder General - SE MI Locations
description_raw:
This job posting is not location specific, it provides candidates to fill the openings throughout SE Michigan.
Rate of Pay and Benefits:
Welders
are paid a top hourly base rate of $44.765, plus applicable shift, overtime, and holiday premiums.  The starting rate for this position is $44.565 with pay increases to the top rate upon completion of three consecutive months of employment.
